This section collects reusable assignment packages and the source files used to generate them.

The former standalone `assets` repository has been migrated into this repository under `teaching-materials/` so the assignments, templates, branding, and build scripts can be maintained with the rest of Tech Edu.

## Assignment packages

The migrated source collection currently includes:

- About Me listening notes and presentation packages
- Name tag assignment package
- Weekly SMART goal and progress log
- Combined teacher-marking materials
- Word and printable variants where available

## Source and templates

The complete source collection is preserved in the Tech Edu repository, including the original Quarto files, templates, build scripts, branding files, and supporting assets.

[Browse the Teaching Materials source on GitHub](https://github.com/mrandrewandrade/tech-edu/tree/master/teaching-materials)
